scope: Local guided browser route at http://127.0.0.1:8914/covenants-v5; real Testnet-10 transactions; no deployment claim.

verification.method: For each stored receipt, fetched its accepting block, verified acceptedTransactionIds from the selected parent, and recovered the exact transaction from the accepting block merge set. Fees recomputed from preceding outputs. Compiled state scripts and payout recipients matched. Final ring and refund outputs queried by address.

sourceHashTiming: Hashes describe source at evidence generation; later accepted-journal retention was added after this live run.

trustBoundaries: All demo owner and recipient roles are controlled by the local host. No independent human counterparties are claimed.
Ring inventory is digital game state. Recipient receipt is a trusted game attestation, not independent proof of physical delivery.
DAA maturity enables a submitted refund branch; the node acceptance does not imply automatic execution or permanent finality.
remainingGaps: Public deployment, CI and public-route verification were not part of this live run.
Historical advanced journals were not retained by the live-run controller; exact public transactions were recovered from the node. A subsequent source change retains future accepted journals.
The early-refund rejection was covered by local VM fixtures, not a deliberately invalid live broadcast.

validation.liveAuditResult: 7 of 7 recorded accepted transactions independently confirmed; fees, contract states, native payouts and unspent final outputs verified
